segments.name: Commercial Engines & Services
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and services commercial jet engines and spare parts for airframers, airlines and third-party MRO shops.
segments.evidence: Commercial Engines & Services (CES) designs, develops, manufactures and services jet engines for commercial airframes, as well as business aviation and aeroderivative applications.

segments.name: Defense & Propulsion Technologies
products: Avio Aero, Unison, Dowty Propellers and Colibrium Additive brands
segments.description: Provides defense engines, avionics, power systems and aircraft components for governments, militaries and commercial airframers.
segments.evidence: Defense & Propulsion Technologies (DPT) is a leading provider of defense engines and critical aircraft systems, and it consists of our Defense & Systems and Propulsion & Additive Technologies businesses.

revenueModel.text: GE Aerospace is paid by airframers, airlines, governments and militaries for jet engines and aircraft systems, and by airlines and MRO shops for maintenance, repair, overhaul and spare parts under long-term service agreements, spare parts agreements or time and material contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: Services include maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) of engines and the sale of spare parts, and we offer services under a variety of arrangements such as long-term service agreements, spare parts agreements or time and material contracts.

changes.text: In 2025, GE substantially completed the restructuring activity related to the separations that created three public companies.
changes.evidence: During the fourth quarter of 2025, we substantially completed separation-related restructuring activity.
